hypotheses.title: Industry-Neutralized LEAPS Option VRP (1080d / 120d)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Neutralizes 1080-day LEAPS variance risk premium across GICS Industries (~70 groups). Industry grouping strikes the optimal balance between granular peer return dispersion (driving Sharpe > 1.35) while structurally de-correlating from subindustry alphas (Self-Correlation < 0.70).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if industry neutralization inflates turnover above 25% or self-correlation exceeds 0.70.
